event_corrections.source: Frames 6386.9-6388.0 (fr/g6/i112.png, i112b.png at 6387.15 vs 6387.6): T locks into the slot with the Mini T-SPIN banner, but no row clears (stack heights and rows identical before/after, no clear flash). Score +300 at 6387.27 (73260->73560) = zero-line mini T-spin, not a line clear (a single would be 300 too but B2B is kept: the next quad at 6388.13 scores +3600 = 2400x1.5). Zero-line spin, not a clear.

Frames 6668.2-6669.0 (fr/g6/i115.png): O spawns 6668.67 (nextcount shift 6668.667), locks and clears one row at 6668.87, the KO frame (p2 board starts tilting in the same frame); banner '11 REN'; score +1950 (80544->82494 at 6668.87) = single 300 + 11 REN x150. Cleared row is coloured stack, no garbage.

Frames 6736.5-6740.3 (fr/g6/i117a.png): only one TETRIS (banner at 6737.0, score +3600 at 6736.87 = B2B tetris after the 6734 TSD); after it only plain locks (score creeps 25388->25541) until the TSD at 6739.97. Chain logs two quads (6736.0 and 6736.97); the second is a duplicate.

Frames 6740.4-6744.7 (fr/g6/i117b.png): TETRIS at ~6741.1 (1 REN, +3750), then a double at ~6742.1 (2 REN, +1232), single 3 REN (~6743.5), single 4 REN (~6744.5). No second tetris; chain quad at 6742.53 (0.1 s after the double) is a phantom.

Frames 6749.9-6752.6 (fr/g6/i117c.png): I taken out of HOLD (nextcount hold 6750.433) clears 4 rows at ~6750.5, TETRIS + BACK to BACK banner, score +3600 at 6750.60 (42822->46422 = 2400x1.5). Rows cleared were coloured stack, no garbage. Chain has no clear in the 16.6 s tail after 6747.47 except this missing one.

The fast burst 6735.5-6736.6 checked frame by frame (fr/g6/i118.png): each shift is a real lock with drop points.
